_doc: ⚑ S321 — 2026 v3, THE SCREENS (docs/reinterp/DESIGN_2026_V3_PRESSURE_2026-11-07.md, his rulings of 7 Nov; built record: docs/reinterp/E4_V3_SCREENS_BUILT_2026-11-07.md). The week Maya turns 18, everyone leaves her except the one voice that wants her gone. Two screens: the laptop carries Kettle (an invented messenger: Mum, Dad, Junie, the house chat); the monitor carries the browser (the news tabs, the clinic portal, the search, Second Thoughts, Photos). All display text is Claude's under the 2026-08-17 norm; his edit wins. Real facts appear only inside the simulated articles and the clinic page, each with its source line, and every one is taken from RESEARCH_2026_TRANS_PRESSURE_2026-11-07.md or RESEARCH_2026_V3_THREADS_2026-11-07.md (opened sources only). Every masthead, app, service and person is invented. No deadname anywhere: the loft photo's sentence is cut before the word.

news._doc: THE SIMULATED ARTICLES — extra layers; the story never needs them. Invented mastheads (his Malta rule), real dated facts, one source line each. A and B are the SAME study read two ways (RESEARCH_2026_TRANS_PRESSURE S1, opened): the headline Mum sends, and the reason most people give. C: the Levy Review (S12 / T2, opened). D: the Trevor Project 2025 survey (S5, opened). Nobody who detransitioned is satirised: the numbers are reported as the study reports them.

articles.head: More than one in eight 'went back', study finds
body: A US survey asked 27,715 trans adults about their lives. Of those who had transitioned, 13.1% said they had detransitioned at some point.
Most named pressure from outside: 82.5% cited at least one external factor, led by pressure from family and stigma.
articles.source: Source: Turban et al., LGBT Health, 1 Jun 2021 (the 2015 US Transgender Survey).

articles.head: Why people stop: pressure from family tops the list
body: 82.5% of those who had detransitioned named at least one outside reason. The most common: pressure from a parent (35.6%).
articles.source: Source: Turban et al., LGBT Health, 1 Jun 2021 (the 2015 US Transgender Survey).

articles.head: Adult gender clinic waits 'up to 15 years'
body: A review of adult gender clinics in England found first appointments can take up to 15 years.
It proposes one national waiting list.
articles.source: Source: the Levy Review, NHS England, 18 Dec 2025 (as reported by PinkNews).

articles.head: 94% of young trans people say the news stresses them
body: In a US survey, 94% of trans and nonbinary young people said recent laws and debates about LGBTQ+ people caused them stress or anxiety.
articles.source: Source: The Trevor Project, 2025 US National Survey, published 6 May 2026.

bot._doc: SECOND THOUGHTS, v3 (beats 10-11). It always answers and it always agrees (sycophancy is documented: RESEARCH_2026_V3_THREADS thread 3). It quotes every refusal back to her as a reason. Satire only in its self-presentation (the goal picture, the ring that never passes 99%, the map, the clip) — and it collapses when Junie is unmuted. It never says 'conversion'; it says help, progress, protect. Invented mark; detrans.ai is never on screen.

An invented AI-made anti-'gender ideology' video: the contagion frame, the 'who is talking to your child' frame, a line that only goes up (tropes as described in RESEARCH_2026_V3_THREADS thread 4, in my own words, never copied). Direct and brute, not violent. It says it is AI-made in its own corner. Invented title and channel; no real people, no faces.

tryon._doc: TRY IT ON (beat 14; src/desktop/apps/mirror.ts). His second ruling: harsher, not softer; the system starts it without asking; the mirror, the reveal of a male body; Junie's link breaks in and ends it; the player cannot. The system's voice only, flat and pleased with itself; it says how natural it looks. Speculative (no documented use of such a tool, RESEARCH_2026_V3_THREADS thread 2).
